subject: Commission Goals and Transportation Planner Advocacy
overview: The commission discussed establishing a mission framework and priorities for 2026, emphasizing the need for a dedicated January meeting. Members also focused on advocating for the city to fill vacant transportation planning positions and reviewed safety concerns regarding state-led rotary projects.

items.title: Announcements and Community Liaison
items.summary: The commission noted upcoming winter community rides and initiated a collaborative partnership with the local Mothers Out Front chapter.

items.title: Commission Goals and Procedures
items.summary: Members agreed to hold a dedicated meeting in January to define their mission framework and set short-term goals for safety, infrastructure, and education.

items.title: Transportation Planning Personnel Advocacy
items.summary: The commission discussed advocating for the city to fill vacant transportation engineer and planner positions to ensure better coordination on infrastructure projects.

items.title: Website and Communication Strategy
items.summary: Bruce Kulik and Noam Ravini will lead updates to the commission's outdated website and coordinate content on winter riding and route planning.

items.title: E-bike Safety and Education
items.summary: The group discussed e-bike classifications and potential safety education campaigns following reports of congestion on shared-use paths.

items.title: Mystic River Infrastructure and Rotary Design
items.summary: The commission expressed safety concerns regarding recent DCR repainting of local rotaries and sought a formal contact at the state level to review future design proposals.

items.title: Local Infrastructure and Program Updates
items.summary: Updates were provided on Clippership Drive crosswalk designs and the successful City Council approval of a bike light donation program.

items.title: Budget and Event Planning
items.summary: The body planned to lobby the mayor for bike rack funding and a proposed pump track during the upcoming budget cycle.

items.title: Public Information and Community Events
items.summary: The commission proposed creating a public Google Calendar to track annual tabling events and discussed biking participation in local schools.
